text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you're quite late today!
All that's left is the "Divine Spicy Ascension MAX Heaven Curry"~.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't have time to go to the store now anyway,
so I'll have that."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (A curry so shockingly spicy that whoever eats it leaps up and bursts right through the gates of heaven—however, skipping a meal would be worse for the body.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(This has gone beyond tough and crossed into pure agony...
Perhaps I shouldn't have forced them into this request.)
